curation: Four variants auditioned per family; variants 1-3 retained.

graveAmbience.prompt: Seamless dark-fantasy grave cloister ambience: cold wind in ruined arches, distant chain, stone dust, candles, and ossuary settling; exactly 20 seconds, perfectly loopable; no music, speech, combat, or bell.

ritualBell.prompt: One cracked bronze cathedral bell strike in a ruined cloister; textured onset, mournful low-mid body, controlled decay; exactly 3.2 seconds; no music or second strike.

meleeRelease.prompt: Hero longsword release through heavy night air with leather and cloth detail; exactly 0.7 seconds; no impact, voice, or magic.

arcaneRelease.prompt: Violet sigil bolt release with glassy grit, ash hiss, and spectral tail; exactly 1.1 seconds; no impact, thunder, voice, or laser.

supportWard.prompt: Protective oath ward from etched silver, chain movement, reversed air, and mineral shimmer; exactly 1.3 seconds; no choir, speech, or cartoon sparkle.

enemyBlade.prompt: Skeleton cleaver or chipped sword release with rust scrape and loose bone joints; exactly 0.7 seconds; no impact or voice.

enemyBow.prompt: Skeleton archer release with sinew string, old yew creak, and bone-fletched arrow hiss; exactly 0.9 seconds; no impact or firearm tone.

combatImpact.prompt: Compact iron, leather, brittle bone, and cloth combat impact with muted stone reflection; exactly 0.6 seconds; no swing, scream, or explosion.

skeletonDeath.prompt: Skeleton collapse onto flagstones with ribs, limb bones, skull knock, and dust; exactly 1 second; no gore, voice, or comedy.

heroWound.prompt: Armored cloth, leather straps, restrained plate knock, and heavy body recoil; exactly 0.8 seconds; no vocalization, gore, or music.

reliquary.prompt: Small iron-bound reliquary latch and wood hinge followed by mineral ember light from within; exactly 1.6 seconds; no coins, fanfare, or mobile-game chime.

upgradeBinding.prompt: Parchment seal, rotating metal tokens, wax, oath rune, mineral pulse, and ash; exactly 2.2 seconds; no choir, melody, or explosion.

uiParchment.prompt: Tiny dry paper slip, restrained brass stylus tick, and faint wax touch; exactly 0.5 seconds; no chime, digital beep, or whoosh.

retries: Ritual bell prompt shortened once after the provider rejected text over 450 characters; no credits charged for the rejected request.
Reliquary and grave-ambience prompts were shortened before submission to satisfy the same provider text limit.
No format conversion or gain processing was applied.
